Meta.title: Circolo del Libro — Padua Book Club
Meta.description: Small reading groups in Padua, each led by a passionate facilitator. Choose a book, join a group, and meet at our partner cafés.

hero.title: Read together, one book at a time.
hero.subtitle: Circolo del Libro brings neighbours together in small, friendly reading groups. Each circle explores a single book, guided by a local facilitator, over coffee at Padua's most-loved cafés.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three simple steps from curious reader to a seat at the table.

step1.title: Choose a book
step1.desc: Browse the active circles and find a story that speaks to you — from timeless classics to bold new voices.

step2.title: Join a group
step2.desc: Reserve one of the limited seats. Groups stay small on purpose, so every voice is heard.

step3.title: Meet at our cafés
step3.desc: Gather with your circle at a partner café in Padua for warm conversation and even warmer coffee.

cta.title: Have a book you love to share?
cta.subtitle: Lead your own circle. We'll match you with a café, help you gather readers, and keep your espresso flowing.

Facilitator.title: Become a Facilitator
Facilitator.subtitle: Turn a book you love into a community. Facilitators spark the conversation, keep the circle welcoming, and set the reading pace.
Facilitator.whatBody: You don't need to be an academic or a professional critic — just an enthusiastic reader. Pick a book, set a rhythm, and guide friendly discussions. We handle the venue and the logistics.
Facilitator.role1: Choose a book and a comfortable reading pace
Facilitator.role2: Host a small group (6–10 readers) at a partner café
Facilitator.role3: Prepare a few questions to spark discussion
Facilitator.role4: Keep the circle warm, inclusive, and on time

perk1.title: Free coffee
perk1.desc: Every session, your drink is on the house at our partner café.

perk2.title: Lead a community
perk2.desc: Build lasting friendships around the stories you care about most.

perk3.title: First pick of books
perk3.desc: Propose any title you're passionate about — you set the reading list.
